final_protocol:
1. Set up the bench with a green ice bucket, tube racks, clear PCR/microcentrifuge tubes, adjustable micropipettes, pipette tips, a Petri dish, and a Bio-Rad real-time PCR thermocycler; keep chilled tubes on ice.

2. Aliquot liquid reagent or sample into clear PCR/microcentrifuge tubes using an adjustable micropipette, working from the orange rack labeled “A” and the yellow rack.

3. Place the filled tubes into the tube rack or directly into the ice bucket to keep them cold.

4. Load the prepared tubes into the Bio-Rad real-time PCR thermocycler and close the instrument lid.

5. Retrieve a chilled tube from the ice bucket and open it for further handling.

6. Pipette liquid into or out of the chilled tube with an adjustable micropipette while holding the tube on ice.

7. Transfer an aliquot from the tube onto the surface of a Petri dish containing translucent agar or liquid medium, then set the Petri dish back on the bench.
